triples.subject: Father Zossima
triples.quote: This is my last message to you: in sorrow seek happiness. Work, work unceasingly.

triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: That bowing to your brother, Dmitri. And didn’t he tap the ground with his forehead, too!

triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: If even you are a sensualist at heart, what of your brother, Ivan? He’s a Karamazov, too.

triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: You’re a Karamazov too, you know! In your family sensuality is carried to a disease.

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: If even you are a sensualist at heart, what of your brother, Ivan? He’s a Karamazov, too.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: Since he has openly abandoned his betrothed for her, he doesn’t despise her.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: Since he has openly abandoned his betrothed for her, he doesn’t despise her.

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: He’s trying to get Mitya’s betrothed for himself, and I fancy he’ll succeed, too.

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: He’ll carry off Katerina Ivanovna, for whom he is languishing, and pocket her dowry of sixty thousand.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: to abandon his betrothed, a rare beauty, Katerina Ivanovna, who’s rich, and the daughter of a colonel

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: I’ve suspected that for a long time, brother, that’s why you don’t like my brother Ivan.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: And by the way, do you remember how your brother Mitya cried out: ‘I will remember!’

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: He’ll carry off Katerina Ivanovna, for whom he is languishing, and pocket her dowry of sixty thousand.

triples.subject: Rakitin
triples.quote: I guess from your warmth that you are not indifferent to Katerina Ivanovna yourself; I’ve suspected that for a long time, brother

triples.subject: Rakitin
triples.quote: that’s why you don’t like my brother Ivan. Are you jealous of him?

triples.subject: Rakitin
triples.quote: Don’t you understand that one might very well dislike him, apart from Katerina Ivanovna. And why the devil should I like him? He condescends to abuse me, you know.

triples.subject: Rakitin
triples.quote: Oh, yes, I’d forgotten she was a relation of yours.” “A relation! That Grushenka a relation of mine!”

triples.subject: Alexey Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: You Karamazovs brag of being an ancient, noble family, though your father used to run about playing the buffoon at other men’s tables
